# Video script: Looks abnormal, is not; looks fine, is not

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-extracted' that no clinician has verified.

| 1 | Four-chamber clip with a thin dark rim | A thin dark rim around the heart, two millimetres or less, is normal. | IS23-027 |
| 2 | Two clips: apical view with septal drop-out; lateral view, septum intact | A gap near the crux with the beam along the septum may be drop-out. Turn the beam across the septum and look again. | IS23-045 |
| 3 | Two four-chamber clips, mid-gestation and third trimester, labelled | Slightly unequal ventricles late in pregnancy can be a variant. Unequal ventricles at mid-gestation need further examination. | IS23-043 |
| 4 | Clip with an occasional ectopic beat, then one with frequent ectopic beats | An occasional skipped beat is common and often benign. Frequent ones, or a rhythm still irregular after more than one to two weeks, need assessment. | IS23-034, IS23-035 |
